description: This file defines an Actor class that manages user session states, including login, logout, and session validation, within a Flask web application.

classes.name: Actor
classes.description: A class that handles user session management, including login status, session setting, and access control decorators.

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Returns the user ID from the session if logged in; otherwise, returns 'err'.

methods.name: set_session
methods.description: Sets the user in the Flask global object based on the session data.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks whether the user is currently logged in based on session data.

methods.name: login_required
methods.description: Decorator that enforces login requirement for a route, redirecting to a sign-in page if not logged in.

methods.name: redirect_if_login
methods.description: Decorator that redirects to a specified path if the user is already logged in.

methods.name: signout
methods.description: Logs out the user by clearing the session key.

methods.name: signin
methods.description: Placeholder method for user sign-in logic.
